config.d-logger.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <!-- Files on the data volume; stderr carries warnings and errors only. -->
  <logger replace="replace">
    <level>information</level>
    <log>/var/lib/clickhouse/logs/clickhouse-server.log</log>
    <errorlog>/var/lib/clickhouse/logs/clickhouse-server.err.log</errorlog>
    <size>1000M</size>
    <count>10</count>
    <console>1</console>
    <console_log_level>warning</console_log_level>
  </logger>
</clickhouse>
config.d-paths.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <!-- Both wildcards, as the image's own docker_related_config.xml does:
       with IPv6 the dual-stack :: also covers IPv4, so binding 0.0.0.0
       fails and listen_try skips it; without IPv6, :: fails and 0.0.0.0
       is used. The stock config.xml's own listen_host lines are
       commented out. -->
  <listen_host>::</listen_host>
  <listen_host>0.0.0.0</listen_host>
  <listen_try>1</listen_try>
  <path>/var/lib/clickhouse/</path>
  <tmp_path>/var/lib/clickhouse/tmp/</tmp_path>
  <user_files_path>/var/lib/clickhouse-user-files/</user_files_path>
  <format_schema_path>/var/lib/clickhouse/format_schemas/</format_schema_path>
  <user_directories>
    <local_directory>
      <path>/var/lib/clickhouse/access/</path>
    </local_directory>
  </user_directories>
</clickhouse>
config.d-ports.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <http_port>8123</http_port>
  <tcp_port>9000</tcp_port>
  <mysql_port remove="remove"/>
  <postgresql_port remove="remove"/>
  <!-- No replicated tables, so no interserver traffic. -->
  <interserver_http_port remove="remove"/>
</clickhouse>
users.d-admin.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <users>
    <!-- With no <grants> element: ALL ON *.* WITH GRANT OPTION, plus
         user and named-collection management from the two flags. This
         is the previous server's admin definition. -->
    <admin>
      <password_sha256_hex from_env="ADMIN_SHA256"/>
      <networks>
        <ip>::/0</ip>
      </networks>
      <profile>default</profile>
      <quota>default</quota>
      <access_management>1</access_management>
      <named_collection_control>1</named_collection_control>
    </admin>
  </users>
</clickhouse>
users.d-default.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <users>
    <!-- No password, so reachable from inside the pod only. Dictionaries
         whose source names no user load as this user. With no <grants>
         element ClickHouse gives a users.xml user ALL ON *.* WITH GRANT
         OPTION, as on the previous server. -->
    <default>
      <networks replace="replace">
        <ip>127.0.0.1</ip>
        <ip>::1</ip>
      </networks>
    </default>
  </users>
</clickhouse>
users.d-mppdb_ro.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <users>
    <mppdb_ro>
      <password_sha256_hex from_env="MPPDB_RO_SHA256"/>
      <networks>
        <ip>::/0</ip>
      </networks>
      <profile>default</profile>
      <quota>default</quota>
      <grants>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON TAP_SCHEMA.*</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON dp2.*</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON ppdb.*</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON ssp.*</query>
        <query>GRANT dictGet ON ssp.visit_exposure_dict</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON system.one</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON system.parts</query>
      </grants>
    </mppdb_ro>
  </users>
</clickhouse>
users.d-ssp_xmatch.xml:
<clickhouse>
  <users>
    <ssp_xmatch>
      <password_sha256_hex from_env="SSP_XMATCH_SHA256"/>
      <networks>
        <ip>::/0</ip>
      </networks>
      <profile>default</profile>
      <quota>default</quota>
      <grants>
        <query>GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON ppdb.DiaSource</query>
        <query>GRANT SELECT ON ssp.*</query>
        <query>GRANT dictGet ON ssp.visit_exposure_dict</query>
      </grants>
    </ssp_xmatch>
  </users>
</clickhouse>
